# Koshtu (Кошту)

> Koshtu is a private, minimalist mobile expense tracker and debt payoff application for iOS and Android. It calculates a dynamic safe daily spending allowance and helps users systematically eliminate debt with 100% offline on-device storage (no bank account linking required).

## Key Information
- **Application Name**: Koshtu (Кошту)
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.koshtu.online
- **Platforms**: iOS (Apple App Store), Android (Google Play)
- **Category**: Personal Finance / Expense Tracking / Debt Payoff
- **Pricing**: Free to download / Freemium
- **Privacy Model**: 100% Offline, Local Storage on device (AsyncStorage). Zero server tracking, no bank credentials or transaction syncing required.
- **Creator & Developer**: Eugen Kovalchuk (https://www.eugenkovalchuk.online)
- **Contact Email**: eugen.bistrosite@gmail.com

## Core Value Proposition & Features
- **Daily Safe Allowance (Щоденний ліміт)**: Automatically calculates how much the user can safely spend today based on the remaining budget and cycle days. Dynamically updates with every transaction.
- **Debt Payoff Tracker (Контроль та повернення боргів)**: Structured debt elimination tool showing total debt, amount repaid, remaining balance, and visual progress indicators for each creditor.
- **Lightning-Fast Expense Entry (Швидке внесення за 2 секунди)**: Custom built-in numeric calculator keypad eliminates keyboard lag and allows logging expenses in two taps.
- **Multi-Currency Support (Мультивалютність)**: Native support for Ukrainian Hryvnia (₴), US Dollar ($), Euro (€), Polish Zloty (zł), and British Pound (£).
- **Zero Banking Risk**: Does not connect to banking APIs or read SMS, providing complete financial confidentiality.

- [Account Deletion](https://www.koshtu.online/account-deletion): Instructions for instant local data wipe or account management.

## Target Audience
- Individuals looking to stop living paycheck to paycheck by knowing their exact daily limit.
- Users who want to pay off consumer debts, personal loans, or credit cards systematically.
- Privacy-conscious people who refuse to share open banking access or bank credentials with third-party servers.
